title: Fix failing unit tests
objective: Correct the failing unit-test behavior and leave the repository with zero failing tests, with implementation and validation evidence recorded separately.

branch.name: WI-0040-fix-failing-unit-tests
branch.rationale: The work item changes repository test behavior and must be isolated from the main branch during implementation and validation.

request.text:
Prepare a new .docs/work-items/WI-0040 to fix failing unit tests. Include a single implementation and a single validation task. Implementation objective is zero failing tests and the validation task objective is to verify zero failing tests.

Commit the completed work item.

scope.name: failing-test-repair
scope.description: Identify and correct the implementation, test fixture, or test-environment defect responsible for the current failing unit test.
scope.reason: The repository currently has a failing unit test that must be repaired without weakening the test gate.

scope.name: zero-failure-test-gate
scope.description: Run the complete repository unit-test command and record evidence that it reports zero failing tests.
scope.reason: A passing implementation requires an executable proof that no unit tests remain failing.

nonGoals.name: test-removal-or-weakening
nonGoals.description: Do not delete, skip, quarantine, weaken, or rewrite a failing test solely to make the test command pass.
nonGoals.reason: The objective is to fix the underlying defect while preserving meaningful regression coverage.

nonGoals.name: unrelated-refactoring
nonGoals.description: Do not expand the change into unrelated feature work, broad refactoring, dependency upgrades, deployment, or production operations.
nonGoals.reason: The work item is limited to the smallest repair needed for zero failing unit tests.

nonGoals.name: false-validation-claim
nonGoals.description: Do not claim zero failing tests from static inspection, a focused subset, or an unexecuted command; the complete configured test suite must run.
nonGoals.reason: Validation evidence must reflect the repository-wide unit-test gate rather than a partial or inferred result.

items.name: zero-failing-tests
items.description: The implementation must correct the cause of the currently failing unit test or tests while preserving the intended test assertions and leave the complete configured unit-test suite with zero failing tests.
items.reason: The requested bugfix is complete only when the repository test gate passes without suppressing coverage.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The implementation task identifies and repairs the underlying cause of the failing unit test or tests without deleting, skipping, quarantining, or weakening the affected assertions.
The complete configured unit-test command exits with code 0 and reports zero failing tests after the implementation change.

items.name: independent-zero-failure-validation
items.description: The validation task must independently execute the complete configured unit-test suite and verify zero failing tests after the implementation task.
items.reason: Implementation-owned checks and final validation are separate evidence responsibilities.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The validation task runs the complete configured unit-test command after the implementation task and records exit code 0 with zero failing tests.
The validation result reports no unresolved test failures and does not infer success from a partial test selection or static inspection.

versionSuggestion.rationale: The requested change is a bounded bugfix intended to restore the existing unit-test contract without adding a new feature.
versionSuggestion.disclaimer: This is an inferred recommendation; increase the impact if the final repair changes a public contract or exceeds the bounded test-fix scope.
